pre_storm|will i lose power.reply:
**Confirmed by AEP:**  
A storm is forecast or active in your area. No outage has been confirmed at your home.  

**Model estimate:**  
Risk Band: Very High. Estimated probability of an outage: 0.558 (≈56%). Main drivers are nearby overhead lines and recent storm damage reports.  

**What you can do:**  
- Stay at least 35 ft from any downed line; call 911 then report it to AEP.  
- Never run a generator indoors or in a garage.  
- Keep refrigerator/freezer doors closed (≈4 h fridge, 48 h freezer).  
- Charge phones and battery packs now; have a flashlight with spare batteries.  
- Store 1 gal of water per person per day and non‑cooking food.  
- Plan a warm/cool shelter and fill your car’s gas tank.
